name: Nova
source:
The Magician of November / The Dimension Magician

A very agreeable man with seemingly the patience of a saint. As the November Magician who watches over parallel worlds, his job is to delete singularities such as Parilyne. However, he decides to resist this fate despite the risks attached. Although he's an extremely generous person, he's self-aware about how his actions are rooted in his messiah complex.

Nova is the founder of the Peacemakers, a charity-like organization that more resembles a friendly mafia. It's composed of talented misfits often disillusioned with the world, or with nowhere to belong. Nova wins them over with sheer charisma and gives them a home, only asking them to help him out and get along until they find another passion in life, if they ever do.

Because of his special traits as the November Magician, his ether affinity is "undefined." He's one of the few beings in the universe who can cross parallel universes, the other being Julius, the Time Magician.

As all the Magicians have inherited a trait from their creator Clavie, Nova shares the same face, voice, and base personality as him. He has quite the complex about it, and it's one of the few things that can set this otherwise pleasant man off.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12601625.nova]official bio[/url]]
